idea-plugin.name: TaskLens Pro
idea-plugin.description:
TaskLens is a developer productivity tool that surfaces all TODO, FIXME, and HACK comments scattered across your codebase into a single, searchable dashboard.

Features:

  • Auto-scans your project for TODO, FIXME, and HACK comments
  • Real-time updates as you edit code
  • Filter by type, priority, and search text
  • Double-click to jump directly to the source line
  • Supports Kotlin, Java, and XML files

Never lose track of a TODO again.
